name: Sakasama no Ondokei
source:
A frigid world with a temperature of -83 degrees Celsius.
The main character, Kou, met a girl with an impossibly short-sleeved shirt during his part-time delivery job!
The secret of the girl and the truth of the incidents surrounding her ...

"Can you be a disliked person for your loved one?"

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5068]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
这是一个气温低至零下83摄氏度的极寒世界。
主人公Kou在兼职送外卖时，遇见了一个穿着短袖的女孩——在这样的天气里，简直不可思议！
女孩隐藏着怎样的秘密，围绕她发生的事件又有着怎样的真相…

“为了重要的人，你愿意变成自己讨厌的那种人吗？”

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5068]NovelGame[/url]]
